verdict.rationale: Gusto ships an official 'Embedded Dev Assistant' MCP server letting AI coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) interact with the Embedded Payroll API and docs, which enables some natural-language-driven interaction, but this is framed as a developer/integration aid rather than an end-user natural-language interface for running payroll or HR tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of an end-user-facing chat/NL command interface for operating payroll itself, and independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP server's usability.
